overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Dynamic Barcelona Elite 1-2 Person Ultra Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a compact, luxurious retreat for wellness enthusiasts. Designed for indoor use, this sauna is perfect for spaces like basements or master baths, providing a serene escape with its Honey Dark Stain Canadian Hemlock wood construction. Featuring 6 ultra low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels, it delivers therapeutic heat to promote muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Enhance your experience with the interior chromotherapy lighting and built-in Bluetooth speakers, creating a personalized spa-like atmosphere at home.

_raw.Product Ad-Copy: Dynamic Saunas are constructed of environmentally-friendly Canadian Hemlock wood planks. Our saunas feature energy PureTech™ Ultra-Low EMF Heating Technology that help relax and rejuvenate the body. Dynamic Saunas can be installed on carpet or any indoor location including basements, master baths, walk in closets or can also be added to a fitness room.
